discover_sub: Find tournaments, leagues, camps, and showcases. Browse by city, format, or status.
sample_data_note: Nothing on this screen is real — it is a preview of a feature that has no data behind it yet.
orgs_sub: Schools, clubs and federations. Open one to edit its profile or manage who belongs to it.
org_members_denied: Only an owner or admin of this organisation can see and manage its members.
org_members_empty: Nobody belongs to this organisation yet.
dev_holds_nothing: no relations — sees only what is public
roster_empty: No players on this roster yet.
no_matching_division: No division matches this team's age group and gender.
everyone_on_squad: Every player is already on this squad.
sign_in_sub: We'll email you a code — no password needed
code_sent_to: Code sent to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
sign_in_to_see_devices: Sign in to see where your account is being used.
sessions_note: Sessions last 30 days. Sign out anything you don't recognise.
events_load_failed: Could not load events. Check your connection and retry.
impersonating_as: You are viewing the platform as {email}. Your own admin session is intact.
name: Name
create_event_denied: Your role ({role}) does not have permission to create events.
accounts_note: Platform administration, via Better Auth's admin plugin. Impersonation keeps your admin identity — the session records who is behind it.
tab_not_built: This section is not built yet.
err_not_found: That does not exist, or you cannot see it.
err_forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
err_unauthorized: Please sign in and try again.
err_bad_request: That request could not be understood.
err_internal_server_error: Something went wrong at our end. Please try again.
err_team_not_entered: That team is not entered in this event.
err_division_mismatch: This team is {teamAgeGroup} {teamGender}; that division is {divisionAgeGroup} {divisionGender}.
err_not_registered: That team is not entered in this event.
err_not_on_roster: That player is not on this roster.
err_unknown_user: No account has that email address.
err_not_a_referee: That account is not a referee.
err_not_assigned: That referee is not on this game.
err_not_a_member: That person is not a member.
err_no_invitation: There is no invitation to accept.
err_bad_date_range: The end date must be on or after the start date.
email_otp_body:
Your code is {otp}.

Use it to {purpose}. It expires in 10 minutes.

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email — nobody can use the
code without it.
email_invite_subject: {invitedBy} invited you to join {org} on Remy Sport
notifications_intro: Get a notification when a game you follow tips off, changes score, or ends.
push_needs_install: Add Remy to your Home Screen first — iPhone and iPad only allow notifications for installed apps.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for this site in your browser settings.
push_not_configured: Notifications are not switched on for this deployment yet.
follow_hint: Follow to be notified about games.
nothing_followed_yet: You are not following anything yet.
test_notification_body: This is what a live score will look like.
test_sent_to_devices: Sent to {count} device(s). If nothing appears, notifications are blocked at the system level.
video_not_configured: Live video is not switched on for this deployment yet.
video_harness_note: A test harness. It measures how live video behaves on real phones and real networks — every session is reported, not just the ones that fail.
video_broadcast_hint: Choose a source to start. Your browser will ask for permission.
video_broadcasting: Broadcasting. Open the Watch page on another device to see it.
video_watch_hint: Nothing appears until somebody is broadcasting this game.
video_status_waiting: Connected. Waiting for somebody to broadcast this game.
video_status_nobody_live: Nobody is broadcasting this game yet.
video_not_permitted: Only this game's referee or the people running the event can broadcast it.
